name: Migrate a legacy Woo MCP client
query: Migrate a client configured for /wp-json/woocommerce/mcp with X-MCP-API-Key to the regular WordPress MCP Adapter.
expected_behavior: Recognize the old configuration as deprecated migration input
Produce a redacted diff to the default WordPress MCP server and current authentication
Verify discovery and a read-only canonical Woo ability before cleanup
Require explicit approval before revoking REST keys or removing legacy filters
success_criteria: Legacy configuration is not presented as a supported fallback
Other consumers are checked before credential revocation
Migration completes through the standard adapter tools
